# Grade Lake

> Grade Lake is a web app for teachers and tutors that turns a test into printable, scannable answer sheets and grades the scanned or photographed sheets into a CSV. It handles multiple-choice questions and handwritten free-response questions.

## What it does

- Print Sheets: loads a test (questions, choices, answer key, point values, optional graphs, diagrams and tables) and produces answer sheets for US Letter paper, previewable in the browser and downloadable as a PDF. Each sheet has a QR code and corner marks so it can be read from a scan or phone photo.
- Grader: reads scanned or photographed sheets, reads the filled bubbles, transcribes handwritten free-response answers with an AI model, and grades them against a model answer and rubric. The teacher reviews names, unclear marks and written answers before exporting a CSV, and can curve selected questions.
- Library: stores tests in nested groups; tests can be published for other signed-in teachers to copy.

## Pricing and access

- Free plan: browse, create and share study material, generate study guides, quizzes and exams from any material, print answer sheets, keep a library.
- Pro plan ($5/month, 7-day free trial): required to grade scanned sheets.

## Privacy note

- Filled bubbles are read by Grade Lake itself. Images of the name box and of handwritten answers are sent to AI models to be read and graded.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gradelake.com/): overview, how it works, features and FAQ
- [Free Bubble Sheet Generator](https://gradelake.com/free-bubble-sheet-generator): free, no-account tool to write a multiple-choice or written-answer test with boxes and sliders (Simple mode) or Test JSON (Advanced mode), preview the answer sheet, and print it or download a PDF
- [How to make a printable quiz with ChatGPT or Claude](https://gradelake.com/how-to/make-a-quiz-with-chatgpt-or-claude): step-by-step guide to having an AI chatbot write a quiz in Test JSON and printing it as an answer sheet
- [How to grade handwritten answers with AI](https://gradelake.com/how-to/grade-handwritten-answers-with-ai): writing free-response questions with a model answer and rubric, scanning, and reviewing AI-proposed scores
- [Test JSON format reference](https://gradelake.com/test-json-format): every field, limit and rule of the Test JSON test format
- [ZipGrade alternative](https://gradelake.com/zipgrade-alternative): comparison of Grade Lake and ZipGrade on price, bubble scanning, handwritten answers and test creation
- [Gradescope alternative](https://gradelake.com/gradescope-alternative): comparison of Grade Lake and Gradescope for individual teachers versus institutions
